name: Low blood sugar (hypoglycaemia)
description: Hypoglycaemia is abnormally low blood sugar levels.

name: Low sperm count
description: Low sperm count (oligospermia) is a common cause of male infertility.

name: Low white blood cell count
description: Low white blood cell count (leukopenia) increases susceptibility to infections.

name: Low-grade brain tumours, see Non-cancerous (benign) brain tumours
description: Benign brain tumours are non-cancerous but can still cause symptoms by pressure.

name: Lung cancer
description: Lung cancer is a leading cause of cancer death worldwide.

name: Lupus
description: Lupus (systemic lupus erythematosus) is a chronic autoimmune disease.

name: Lyme disease
description: Lyme disease is a tick-borne illness caused by Borrelia bacteria.

name: Lymphoedema
description: Lymphoedema is swelling caused by accumulation of lymph fluid.
treatment: Compression therapy and manual lymphatic drainage

name: Lymphoma (Hodgkin), see Hodgkin lymphoma
description: Hodgkin lymphoma is a cancer of the lymphatic system.

name: Lymphoma (non-Hodgkin)
symptoms: Swollen lymph nodes, fever, weight loss
description: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma is a diverse group of lymphoid malignancies.

name: Macular degeneration (age-related)
description: Age-related macular degeneration is a leading cause of vision loss in older adults.
treatment: Anti-VEGF therapy for wet type, nutritional supplements for dry type

name: Macular hole
description: A macular hole is a small break in the macula, the central part of the retina.

name: Malaria
causes: Plasmodium parasites transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes
description: Malaria is a life-threatening parasitic disease transmitted by mosquitoes.
first_aid: Seek medical care in endemic areas

name: Male menopause, see The 'male menopause'
description: The 'male menopause' (andropause) refers to age-related decline in testosterone levels.

name: Malignant brain tumour (brain cancer)
description: Malignant brain tumours are aggressive cancers of the brain tissue.
first_aid: Seek medical evaluation for new neurological symptoms

name: Mallet finger
description: Mallet finger is an injury to the extensor tendon causing drooping of the fingertip.

name: Malnutrition
description: Malnutrition is a deficiency or imbalance of nutrients in the body.

name: Marfan syndrome
symptoms: Tall stature, long limbs, aortic aneurysm
description: Marfan syndrome is a connective tissue disorder affecting the skeleton, eyes, and cardiovascular system.
treatment: Regular monitoring and surgical intervention if needed

name: Mastitis
description: Mastitis is inflammation of breast tissue, often occurring in breastfeeding women.

name: Mastocytosis
description: Mastocytosis is a disorder characterized by excessive mast cell accumulation.

name: Mastoiditis
symptoms: Pain behind the ear, fever, swelling
description: Mastoiditis is inflammation of the mastoid bone behind the ear.

name: Measles
description: Measles is a highly contagious viral illness preventable by vaccination.
drugs: Vitamin A supplementation in severe cases

name: Medically unexplained symptoms
symptoms: Physical symptoms without identifiable medical cause
description: Medically unexplained symptoms are physical symptoms not fully explained by a medical condition.

name: Melanoma skin cancer
description: Melanoma is the most dangerous form of skin cancer.

name: Meningitis
description: Meningitis is inflammation of the membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord.
treatment: Antibiotics for bacterial, supportive care for viral

name: Meniscus tear (knee cartilage damage)
description: Meniscus tear is damage to the cartilage in the knee joint.

name: Menopause (early), see Early or premature menopause
symptoms: Hot flashes, irregular periods before age 40
description: Premature menopause is menopause occurring before age 40.

name: Menopause and perimenopause
symptoms: Hot flashes, night sweats, mood changes
description: Menopause is the permanent cessation of menstruation; perimenopause is the transition phase.

name: Mesothelioma
description: Mesothelioma is a rare cancer of the lining of the lungs or abdomen, strongly linked to asbestos.

name: Metabolic syndrome
symptoms: High blood pressure, high blood sugar, abdominal obesity
description: Metabolic syndrome is a cluster of conditions increasing risk of heart disease and diabetes.

name: Middle East respiratory syndrome (MERS)
description: MERS is a viral respiratory illness caused by a coronavirus.

name: Migraine
symptoms: Throbbing headache, nausea, sensitivity to light
description: Migraine is a neurological disorder causing recurrent moderate to severe headaches.
first_aid: Rest in a dark, quiet room

name: Miscarriage
description: Miscarriage is the spontaneous loss of a pregnancy before 20 weeks.
first_aid: Seek medical evaluation for bleeding in pregnancy

name: Molar pregnancy
description: Molar pregnancy is an abnormal pregnancy where the placenta develops into a mass of cysts.

name: Moles
description: Moles are common pigmented skin growths that are usually benign.

name: Molluscum contagiosum
description: Molluscum contagiosum is a viral skin infection causing small, flesh-colored bumps.

name: Morton's neuroma
causes: Compression of the nerve between toes
symptoms: Pain in the ball of the foot
description: Morton's neuroma is a painful condition affecting the ball of the foot.

name: Motion sickness
causes: Conflict between visual and vestibular input
description: Motion sickness is a common condition caused by mismatched sensory inputs during travel.

name: Motor neurone disease (MND)
description: Motor neurone disease is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder affecting motor neurons.

name: Mouth cancer
symptoms: Persistent ulcer or lump in the mouth
description: Mouth cancer is a malignancy of the oral cavity.

name: Mouth thrush, see Oral thrush (mouth thrush)
description: Oral thrush is a fungal infection of the mouth caused by Candida.

name: Mouth ulcers
description: Mouth ulcers (aphthous ulcers) are common painful sores inside the mouth.
treatment: Topical treatments and avoidance of triggers

name: Mpox
description: Mpox is a viral illness similar to smallpox but generally milder.

name: MRSA
description: MRSA is a type of staph bacteria resistant to many antibiotics.
first_aid: Seek medical care for skin infections

name: Mucositis
description: Mucositis is inflammation and ulceration of the mucous membranes, often a side effect of cancer treatment.

name: Multiple sclerosis
description: Multiple sclerosis is an autoimmune disease affecting the central nervous system.

name: Multiple system atrophy (MSA)
description: Multiple system atrophy is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder.

name: Mumps
description: Mumps is a contagious viral infection causing swollen salivary glands.

name: Munchausen syndrome
description: Munchausen syndrome is a factitious disorder where individuals feign illness.

name: Muscular dystrophy
description: Muscular dystrophy is a group of genetic diseases causing progressive weakness and loss of muscle mass.

name: Myalgic encephalomyelitis or chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS)
description: Myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome is a complex disorder causing profound fatigue.

name: Myasthenia gravis
description: Myasthenia gravis is an autoimmune neuromuscular disorder causing fluctuating muscle weakness.

name: Myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS)
causes: Bone marrow disorder with ineffective blood cell production
description: Myelodysplastic syndromes are a group of disorders caused by poorly formed blood cells.
treatment: Supportive care, chemotherapy, or stem cell transplant

name: Myeloma
description: Multiple myeloma is a cancer of plasma cells in the bone marrow.

name: Myopia, see Short-sightedness (myopia)
description: Myopia (short-sightedness) is a refractive error where distant objects appear blurred.

name: Myositis
description: Myositis is inflammation of the muscles causing weakness.

name: Ménière's disease
causes: Abnormal fluid in the inner ear
description: Ménière's disease is a disorder of the inner ear causing vertigo and hearing loss.

name: Nail fungal infection
description: Fungal nail infection (onychomycosis) is a common infection of the nails.

name: Nappy rash
causes: Prolonged exposure to moisture and irritants
symptoms: Red, irritated skin in diaper area
description: Nappy rash is irritation of the skin in the diaper area of infants.
first_aid: Frequent diaper changes and air exposure

name: Narcolepsy
description: Narcolepsy is a chronic sleep disorder causing excessive daytime sleepiness and sudden sleep attacks.

name: Nasal and sinus cancer
description: Nasal and sinus cancer is a rare malignancy of the nasal cavity and sinuses.

name: Nasal polyps
description: Nasal polyps are noncancerous growths in the lining of the nasal passages.

name: Nasopharyngeal cancer
description: Nasopharyngeal cancer is a malignancy in the upper part of the throat behind the nose.

name: Necrotising fasciitis
causes: Group A Streptococcus or other bacteria
description: Necrotising fasciitis is a rapidly progressing, life-threatening bacterial infection of the fascia.

name: Neonatal herpes (herpes in a baby)
causes: Herpes simplex virus transmitted during birth
description: Neonatal herpes is a serious herpes simplex virus infection in newborns.

name: Nephrotic syndrome in children
causes: Minimal change disease or other glomerular disorders
description: Nephrotic syndrome is a kidney disorder causing heavy proteinuria and edema.

name: Neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1)
description: Neurofibromatosis type 1 is a genetic disorder causing tumors on nerve tissue.

name: Neurofibromatosis type 2 (NF2)
description: Neurofibromatosis type 2 is a genetic disorder causing tumors on nerves, particularly acoustic neuromas.

name: Neuromyelitis optica (NMO)
description: Neuromyelitis optica is an autoimmune disorder affecting the optic nerves and spinal cord.

name: Newborn jaundice, see Jaundice in babies
symptoms: Yellowing of skin and eyes in newborns
description: Neonatal jaundice is common in newborns due to immature liver function.
treatment: Phototherapy or exchange transfusion if severe

name: Newborn respiratory distress syndrome
description: Newborn respiratory distress syndrome is a breathing disorder in premature infants.

name: Night terrors and nightmares
description: Night terrors are episodes of intense fear during non-REM sleep; nightmares occur during REM sleep.

name: Noise sensitivity (hyperacusis)
causes: Damage to auditory system or central processing issues
description: Hyperacusis is increased sensitivity to sound that would not normally bother most people.

name: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD)
symptoms: Often asymptomatic; fatigue in advanced stages
description: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease is fat accumulation in the liver not caused by alcohol.

name: Non-allergic rhinitis
description: Non-allergic rhinitis causes nasal symptoms without an allergic cause.

name: Non-cancerous (benign) brain tumours
description: Benign brain tumours are non-cancerous but can still cause symptoms by pressure.

name: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma
symptoms: Swollen lymph nodes, fever, weight loss
description: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma is a diverse group of lymphoid malignancies.

name: Non-melanoma skin cancer
description: Non-melanoma skin cancer includes basal cell and squamous cell carcinoma.

name: Noonan syndrome
symptoms: Short stature, heart defects, characteristic facial features
description: Noonan syndrome is a genetic disorder affecting normal development.

name: Norovirus (vomiting bug)
description: Norovirus is a highly contagious virus causing gastroenteritis.

name: Nosebleed
description: Nosebleed (epistaxis) is bleeding from the blood vessels in the nose.
first_aid: Pinch the soft part of the nose and lean forward
treatment: Direct pressure and cauterization if recurrent

name: Obesity, see Overweight and obesity in adults
causes: Excess calorie intake, sedentary lifestyle, genetics
description: Obesity is excessive body fat that increases health risks.

name: Obsessive compulsive disorder (OCD)
description: Obsessive-compulsive disorder involves unwanted thoughts and repetitive behaviors.

name: Oesophageal atresia and tracheo-oesophageal fistula
description: Oesophageal atresia is a congenital defect where the oesophagus does not develop properly.

name: Oesophageal cancer
description: Oesophageal cancer is a malignancy of the oesophagus.

name: Oral thrush (mouth thrush)
description: Oral thrush is a fungal infection of the mouth caused by Candida.

name: Orf
causes: Orf virus from sheep or goats
description: Orf is a viral skin infection acquired from sheep or goats.

name: Osteoarthritis
causes: Wear and tear of joint cartilage
description: Osteoarthritis is the most common form of arthritis caused by breakdown of joint cartilage.
treatment: Physical therapy and joint replacement in severe cases

name: Osteomalacia, see Rickets and osteomalacia
description: Osteomalacia is softening of the bones due to vitamin D deficiency in adults.

name: Osteomyelitis
description: Osteomyelitis is an infection in a bone.

name: Osteophyte (bone spur)
description: Osteophytes are bony projections that form along joint margins.

name: Osteoporosis
description: Osteoporosis is a condition of reduced bone density increasing fracture risk.

name: Otosclerosis
causes: Abnormal bone growth in the middle ear
description: Otosclerosis is abnormal bone growth in the middle ear leading to hearing loss.

name: Ovarian cancer
description: Ovarian cancer is a malignancy of the ovaries, often diagnosed at an advanced stage.

name: Ovarian cyst
description: Ovarian cysts are fluid-filled sacs on the ovary, usually benign.
treatment: Observation or surgical removal if large or symptomatic

name: Overactive thyroid (hyperthyroidism)
description: Hyperthyroidism is overproduction of thyroid hormones.

name: Overweight and obesity in adults
causes: Excess calorie intake, sedentary lifestyle, genetics
description: Overweight and obesity are excessive body fat that increases health risks.

name: Paget's disease of bone
description: Paget's disease of bone is a chronic disorder causing enlarged and weakened bones.

name: Paget's disease of the nipple
description: Paget's disease of the nipple is a rare form of breast cancer.

name: Pancreatic cancer
description: Pancreatic cancer is an aggressive malignancy with poor prognosis.

name: Pancreatitis (chronic)
causes: Long-term alcohol use or genetic factors
description: Chronic pancreatitis is long-standing inflammation of the pancreas leading to permanent damage.

name: Panic disorder
description: Panic disorder involves recurrent unexpected panic attacks with fear of future attacks.

name: Parkinson's disease
description: Parkinson's disease is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder affecting movement.

name: Patau's syndrome
description: Patau's syndrome is a chromosomal disorder caused by an extra chromosome 13.

name: Pelvic inflammatory disease
description: Pelvic inflammatory disease is an infection of the female reproductive organs.

name: Pelvic organ prolapse
description: Pelvic organ prolapse occurs when pelvic organs descend due to weakened support.

name: Pemphigus vulgaris
description: Pemphigus vulgaris is a rare autoimmune blistering disease.

name: Penile cancer
symptoms: Growth or sore on the penis
description: Penile cancer is a rare malignancy of the penis.

name: Peptic ulcer, see Stomach ulcer
description: Peptic ulcers are sores in the lining of the stomach or duodenum.
treatment: Acid suppression and H. pylori eradication

name: Perforated eardrum
symptoms: Sudden ear pain followed by relief, discharge
description: A perforated eardrum is a hole or tear in the tympanic membrane.
first_aid: Keep ear dry and seek medical care
treatment: Most heal spontaneously; surgery if persistent

name: Pericarditis
symptoms: Sharp chest pain worse with lying down
description: Pericarditis is inflammation of the pericardium surrounding the heart.

name: Perinatal anxiety, see Anxiety in pregnancy
description: Perinatal anxiety is anxiety occurring during pregnancy or the postpartum period.

name: Periods
description: Periods (menstruation) are the monthly shedding of the uterine lining.

name: Periods (heavy), see Heavy periods
description: Heavy periods (menorrhagia) involve abnormally heavy or prolonged bleeding.

name: Peripheral arterial disease (PAD)
description: Peripheral arterial disease is narrowing of arteries reducing blood flow to limbs.
treatment: Lifestyle changes and revascularization if severe

name: Peripheral neuropathy
description: Peripheral neuropathy is damage to peripheral nerves causing sensory and motor symptoms.
treatment: Treat underlying cause and symptomatic relief

name: Peritonitis
description: Peritonitis is inflammation of the peritoneum, often due to perforation.

name: Personality disorders
description: Personality disorders are enduring patterns of inner experience and behavior that deviate from cultural norms.

name: Peyronie's disease
description: Peyronie's disease is fibrous scar tissue causing curved, painful erections.

name: Phaeochromocytoma
description: Phaeochromocytoma is a rare tumor producing excess catecholamines.

name: Phimosis, see Tight foreskin (phimosis)
description: Phimosis is a condition where the foreskin cannot be retracted over the glans.

name: Phlebitis (superficial thrombophlebitis)
description: Superficial thrombophlebitis is inflammation of a superficial vein with clot formation.

name: Phobias
symptoms: Intense fear of specific objects or situations
description: Phobias are intense, irrational fears of specific objects or situations.

name: Piles (haemorrhoids)
description: Haemorrhoids are swollen veins in the anus and lower rectum.
treatment: Dietary fiber, topical treatments, or surgery

name: Pilonidal sinus
description: Pilonidal sinus is a chronic abscess near the tailbone containing hair.

name: PIP breast implants
description: PIP breast implants were defective silicone implants that led to health concerns.

name: Pityriasis rosea
symptoms: Herald patch followed by Christmas tree rash
description: Pityriasis rosea is a self-limiting rash that often starts with a herald patch.

name: Pityriasis versicolor
description: Pityriasis versicolor is a fungal infection causing discolored skin patches.

name: Plantar fasciitis
causes: Overuse or strain of plantar fascia
symptoms: Heel pain worse in the morning
description: Plantar fasciitis is inflammation of the thick band of tissue on the bottom of the foot.

name: Pleurisy
symptoms: Sharp chest pain worse with breathing
description: Pleurisy is inflammation of the pleura causing chest pain with breathing.

name: PMS (premenstrual syndrome)
description: Premenstrual syndrome involves physical and emotional symptoms before menstruation.

name: Pneumonia
description: Pneumonia is an infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs.
first_aid: Seek medical care for respiratory symptoms

name: Poisoning
causes: Ingestion, inhalation, or absorption of toxins
description: Poisoning is exposure to a substance that causes harm.
first_aid: Call poison control and follow instructions

name: Polio
description: Polio is a viral disease that can cause paralysis, now largely prevented by vaccination.

name: Polycystic kidney disease (autosomal dominant)
causes: Mutations in PKD1 or PKD2 genes
description: Autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease causes multiple cysts in the kidneys.

name: Polycystic kidney disease (autosomal recessive)
description: Autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease is a severe childhood form.

name: Polycystic ovary syndrome
symptoms: Irregular periods, excess hair growth, infertility
description: Polycystic ovary syndrome is a hormonal disorder causing enlarged ovaries with small cysts.

name: Polyhydramnios (too much amniotic fluid)
description: Polyhydramnios is excess amniotic fluid during pregnancy.

name: Polymorphic light eruption
description: Polymorphic light eruption is a common photosensitivity disorder.

name: Polymyalgia rheumatica
symptoms: Pain and stiffness in shoulders and hips
description: Polymyalgia rheumatica is an inflammatory disorder causing muscle pain and stiffness.

name: Pompholyx (dyshidrotic eczema)
symptoms: Itchy blisters on hands and feet
description: Pompholyx is a type of eczema causing small, itchy blisters on the hands and feet.

name: Post-herpetic neuralgia
symptoms: Burning, stabbing pain in the area of previous rash
description: Post-herpetic neuralgia is persistent nerve pain after a shingles outbreak.
treatment: Neuropathic pain medications and topical lidocaine

name: Postnatal depression
description: Postnatal depression is depression occurring after childbirth.

name: Postpartum psychosis
description: Postpartum psychosis is a rare but serious psychiatric emergency after childbirth.

name: Postural tachycardia syndrome (PoTS)
causes: Dysfunction of the autonomic nervous system
symptoms: Rapid heart rate upon standing, dizziness
description: Postural tachycardia syndrome is a form of dysautonomia causing increased heart rate on standing.
treatment: Increased salt and fluid intake, compression garments

name: Prader-Willi syndrome
description: Prader-Willi syndrome is a genetic disorder causing insatiable appetite and developmental issues.
treatment: Growth hormone and strict food supervision

name: Pre-eclampsia
description: Pre-eclampsia is a pregnancy complication characterized by high blood pressure and organ damage.

name: Pregnancy
description: Pregnancy is the state of carrying a developing embryo or fetus.

name: Premature ejaculation
description: Premature ejaculation is a common sexual dysfunction.

name: Pressure ulcers (pressure sores)
symptoms: Redness, open wounds over bony areas
description: Pressure ulcers are injuries to skin and underlying tissue from prolonged pressure.

name: Prickly heat, see Heat rash (prickly heat)
description: Heat rash (miliaria) is caused by blocked sweat ducts.

name: Primary biliary cholangitis
description: Primary biliary cholangitis is a chronic liver disease destroying small bile ducts.
treatment: Ursodeoxycholic acid and liver transplant in end-stage

name: Problems swallowing pills
description: Problems swallowing pills can be due to technique or underlying esophageal issues.
treatment: Alternative formulations or therapy for underlying cause

name: Progressive supranuclear palsy
description: Progressive supranuclear palsy is a rare neurodegenerative disorder.

name: Prosopagnosia (face blindness)
description: Prosopagnosia is the inability to recognize familiar faces.

name: Prostate cancer
description: Prostate cancer is one of the most common cancers in men.

name: Prostate enlargement
description: Benign prostate enlargement (benign prostatic hyperplasia) is common in older men.

name: Prostatitis
description: Prostatitis is inflammation of the prostate gland.

name: Psoriasis
description: Psoriasis is a chronic autoimmune condition causing rapid skin cell turnover.
treatment: Topical treatments, phototherapy, or systemic therapy

name: Psoriatic arthritis
description: Psoriatic arthritis is inflammatory arthritis associated with psoriasis.

name: Psychosis
description: Psychosis is a mental state involving loss of contact with reality.

name: Psychotic depression
causes: Severe major depression with psychotic features
description: Psychotic depression is major depression accompanied by psychotic symptoms.

name: PTSD (post-traumatic stress disorder)
description: Post-traumatic stress disorder develops after experiencing or witnessing a traumatic event.

name: Puberty (early or delayed)
symptoms: Early or absent development of secondary sexual characteristics
description: Early or delayed puberty refers to abnormal timing of pubertal development.

name: Pubic lice
description: Pubic lice are parasitic insects infesting the pubic hair.

name: Pudendal neuralgia
causes: Compression or injury to pudendal nerve
description: Pudendal neuralgia is chronic pain in the distribution of the pudendal nerve.

name: Pulmonary embolism
causes: Blood clot from DVT traveling to lungs
symptoms: Sudden shortness of breath, chest pain
description: Pulmonary embolism is a blood clot blocking a lung artery.

name: Pulmonary fibrosis
causes: Idiopathic or secondary to other conditions
description: Pulmonary fibrosis is scarring of the lungs leading to stiffness.

name: Pulmonary hypertension
causes: Idiopathic or secondary to lung/heart disease
description: Pulmonary hypertension is high blood pressure in the arteries to the lungs.

name: Pyoderma gangrenosum
causes: Neutrophilic dermatosis, often associated with IBD
description: Pyoderma gangrenosum is a rare ulcerative skin condition.

name: Q fever
description: Q fever is a zoonotic disease caused by Coxiella burnetii.
first_aid: Seek medical care for flu-like symptoms after animal exposure

name: Quinsy, see Tonsillitis
symptoms: Severe sore throat, difficulty swallowing, drooling
description: Quinsy (peritonsillar abscess) is a collection of pus beside the tonsil.

name: Rabies
description: Rabies is a fatal viral disease transmitted by animal bites.
first_aid: Immediate wound cleaning and post-exposure prophylaxis

name: Raynaud's
symptoms: Color changes in fingers/toes with cold or stress
description: Raynaud's phenomenon is episodic color changes in extremities due to vasospasm.

name: Reactive arthritis
description: Reactive arthritis is joint inflammation following an infection elsewhere in the body.

name: Rectal cancer, see Bowel cancer
symptoms: Rectal bleeding, change in bowel habits
description: Rectal cancer is a malignancy of the rectum.

name: Reflux in babies
description: Reflux in babies is common regurgitation due to immature digestive system.

name: Renal cancer, see Kidney cancer
description: Kidney cancer (renal cell carcinoma) is a malignancy of the kidney.

name: Repetitive strain injury (RSI)
description: Repetitive strain injury results from overuse of muscles, tendons, and nerves.

name: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)
symptoms: Cough, wheezing, respiratory distress in infants
description: RSV is a common respiratory virus causing bronchiolitis in young children.
treatment: Supportive care and hospitalization if severe

name: Respiratory tract infections (RTIs)
description: Respiratory tract infections range from common cold to pneumonia.

name: Restless legs syndrome
symptoms: Unpleasant sensations and urge to move legs
description: Restless legs syndrome causes uncomfortable sensations and an urge to move the legs.

name: Restricted growth (dwarfism)
description: Restricted growth (dwarfism) refers to conditions causing significantly short stature.

name: Retinal detachment
causes: Tear in the retina allowing fluid to separate it
symptoms: Sudden floaters, flashes, curtain-like vision loss
description: Retinal detachment is a medical emergency where the retina pulls away from its supporting tissue.

name: Retinal migraine
symptoms: Temporary vision loss in one eye
description: Retinal migraine causes temporary visual disturbances in one eye.

name: Retinoblastoma
description: Retinoblastoma is the most common eye cancer in children.

name: Rett syndrome
symptoms: Loss of purposeful hand skills, repetitive hand movements
description: Rett syndrome is a rare genetic neurological disorder primarily affecting girls.

name: Reye's syndrome
causes: Associated with aspirin use in children with viral illness
description: Reye's syndrome is a rare but serious condition causing swelling in the brain and liver damage.

name: Rhesus disease, see Haemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn (HDFN)
description: Haemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn is caused by maternal antibodies attacking fetal red blood cells.

name: Rheumatic fever
description: Rheumatic fever is an inflammatory disease following group A streptococcal infection.

name: Rheumatoid arthritis
description: Rheumatoid arthritis is a chronic autoimmune disease causing joint inflammation.

name: Rhinitis (allergic), see Allergic rhinitis
causes: Allergens such as pollen, dust mites
description: Allergic rhinitis is inflammation of the nasal passages due to allergens.

name: Rickets and osteomalacia
description: Rickets is softening and weakening of bones in children; osteomalacia is the adult form.

name: Ringworm
description: Ringworm is a fungal skin infection causing ring-shaped lesions.

name: Rosacea
description: Rosacea is a chronic skin condition causing facial redness and visible blood vessels.
first_aid: Avoid triggers like heat and spicy foods

name: Roseola
description: Roseola is a common childhood viral illness causing high fever and rash.

name: Roundworm, see Worms in humans
description: Roundworm infection is a common intestinal parasite.

name: RSV, see Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)
symptoms: Cough, wheezing, respiratory distress in infants
description: RSV is a common respiratory virus causing bronchiolitis in young children.
treatment: Supportive care and hospitalization if severe

name: Rubella (german measles)
description: Rubella is a viral infection causing mild rash illness but dangerous in pregnancy.

name: Salivary gland stones
symptoms: Pain and swelling of salivary gland, especially during meals
description: Salivary gland stones (sialolithiasis) block the flow of saliva.
first_aid: Massage the gland and suck on sour candy

name: Sarcoidosis
description: Sarcoidosis is a multisystem granulomatous disease of unknown cause.

name: Scabies
description: Scabies is a contagious skin infestation caused by the mite Sarcoptes scabiei.
treatment: Topical permethrin and treatment of contacts

name: Scarlet fever
description: Scarlet fever is a bacterial illness caused by group A Streptococcus.

name: Scars
description: Scars are fibrous tissue replacing normal skin after injury.
treatment: Silicone sheets, steroid injections, or laser therapy

name: Schistosomiasis (bilharzia)
description: Schistosomiasis is a parasitic disease caused by flatworms.

name: Schizophrenia
description: Schizophrenia is a chronic mental disorder with distorted thinking and perception.

name: Sciatica
symptoms: Pain radiating from lower back to leg
description: Sciatica is pain along the sciatic nerve pathway.

name: Scleroderma
description: Scleroderma is a group of autoimmune diseases causing skin and connective tissue hardening.

name: Scoliosis
symptoms: Abnormal lateral curvature of the spine
description: Scoliosis is an abnormal sideways curvature of the spine.
treatment: Bracing or surgery in severe cases

name: Scurvy
description: Scurvy is a disease resulting from severe vitamin C deficiency.

name: Seasonal affective disorder (SAD)
description: Seasonal affective disorder is a type of depression related to seasonal changes.

name: Seizures (children with fever), see Febrile seizures
description: Febrile seizures are convulsions triggered by fever in young children.
first_aid: Protect from injury and time the seizure

name: Selective mutism
symptoms: Inability to speak in certain social situations
description: Selective mutism is an anxiety disorder where a person is unable to speak in specific situations.

name: Self-harm
description: Self-harm is the intentional injury to one's own body as a way to cope with emotional distress.

name: Sepsis
description: Sepsis is a life-threatening response to infection causing organ dysfunction.
treatment: Antibiotics and supportive care in ICU

name: Septic arthritis
description: Septic arthritis is a serious joint infection requiring prompt treatment.

name: Septic shock
causes: Severe sepsis leading to low blood pressure
description: Septic shock is a life-threatening complication of sepsis.
treatment: Aggressive fluid resuscitation and supportive care

name: Sexually transmitted infections (STIs)
causes: Bacteria, viruses, or parasites transmitted sexually
description: Sexually transmitted infections are infections spread through sexual contact.

name: Shin splints
description: Shin splints are pain along the inner edge of the shinbone.
treatment: Rest and gradual return to activity

name: Shingles
symptoms: Painful rash in a dermatomal distribution
description: Shingles is a reactivation of the chickenpox virus causing a painful rash.

name: Short-sightedness (myopia)
description: Myopia (short-sightedness) is a refractive error where distant objects appear blurred.

name: Shoulder impingement
description: Shoulder impingement is compression of rotator cuff tendons in the shoulder.

name: Sick building syndrome
symptoms: Headache, fatigue, irritation of eyes and throat
description: Sick building syndrome is a condition associated with poor indoor air quality in buildings.
treatment: Improve building ventilation and air quality

name: Sickle cell disease
description: Sickle cell disease is an inherited blood disorder causing red blood cells to become sickle-shaped.
first_aid: Pain management and hydration during crises

name: Silicosis
description: Silicosis is a lung disease caused by inhaling silica dust.

name: Sinusitis (sinus infection)
description: Sinusitis is inflammation of the sinuses, often following a cold.

name: Sjögren's syndrome
description: Sjögren's syndrome is an autoimmune disorder affecting moisture-producing glands.

name: Skin abscess
description: A skin abscess is a localized collection of pus resulting from infection.

name: Skin cancer (melanoma)
description: Melanoma is the most dangerous form of skin cancer.

name: Skin cancer (non-melanoma)
description: Non-melanoma skin cancer includes basal cell and squamous cell carcinoma.

name: Skin cyst
description: Skin cysts are closed sacs filled with fluid or semi-solid material.

name: Skin picking disorder
symptoms: Recurrent picking at skin leading to lesions
description: Skin picking disorder is a body-focused repetitive behavior causing skin damage.

name: Skin tags
description: Skin tags are benign, small, fleshy growths on the skin.

name: Slapped cheek syndrome
description: Slapped cheek syndrome (erythema infectiosum) is a common childhood viral illness.

name: Sleep apnoea
description: Sleep apnoea is repeated pauses in breathing during sleep.

name: Sleep paralysis
symptoms: Temporary inability to move upon waking
description: Sleep paralysis is a temporary inability to move or speak while falling asleep or waking up.

name: Sleepiness, see Excessive daytime sleepiness (hypersomnia)
description: Hypersomnia is excessive daytime sleepiness despite adequate nighttime sleep.

name: Sleepwalking
causes: Disorder of arousal from non-REM sleep
symptoms: Walking or performing activities while asleep
description: Sleepwalking is a parasomnia involving complex behaviors during sleep.
treatment: Safety measures and improve sleep hygiene

name: Slipped disc
description: A slipped disc (herniated disc) occurs when the soft center of a spinal disc pushes out.
treatment: Physical therapy or surgery if severe

name: Snake bites
description: Snake bites can cause local tissue damage or systemic envenomation.

name: Social anxiety (social phobia)
description: Social anxiety disorder is an intense fear of social situations where one may be judged.

name: Soft tissue sarcoma
description: Soft tissue sarcoma is a cancer that begins in the soft tissues of the body.

name: Solar keratoses, see Actinic keratoses (solar keratoses)
symptoms: Rough, scaly patches on sun-exposed skin
description: Actinic keratosis is a precancerous lesion from sun damage.

name: Sperm count (low), see Low sperm count
description: Low sperm count (oligospermia) is a common cause of male infertility.

name: Spina bifida
symptoms: Varies from mild to severe neurological deficits
description: Spina bifida is a birth defect where the spine and spinal cord do not form properly.

name: Spinal muscular atrophy (SMA)
description: Spinal muscular atrophy is a genetic disorder affecting motor neurons.

name: Spondylolisthesis
description: Spondylolisthesis is when one vertebra slips forward over the one below it.

name: Sprains and strains
causes: Overstretching or tearing of ligaments or muscles
description: Sprains and strains are common soft tissue injuries.

name: Squint
description: Squint (strabismus) is misalignment of the eyes.

name: Stammering
description: Stammering (stuttering) is a speech disorder with disrupted fluency.

name: Staph infection
description: Staph infections are caused by Staphylococcus bacteria, ranging from minor skin infections to serious conditions.
first_aid: Seek medical care for spreading redness

name: Steroid misuse, see Anabolic steroid misuse
description: Anabolic steroid misuse leads to hormonal imbalances and serious health risks.

name: Stevens-Johnson syndrome
symptoms: Widespread skin blistering and mucosal involvement
description: Stevens-Johnson syndrome is a severe, life-threatening skin reaction, often to medication.
first_aid: Stop offending drug and seek emergency care

name: Stillbirth
description: Stillbirth is the loss of a baby after 20 weeks of pregnancy.
treatment: Induction of labour and supportive care

name: Sting or bite (insect), see Insect bites and stings
description: Insect bites and stings cause localized reactions and sometimes systemic effects.
first_aid: Remove stinger if present, clean area

name: Stomach cancer
description: Stomach cancer (gastric cancer) is a malignancy of the stomach lining.

name: Stomach ulcer
causes: H. pylori infection or NSAID use
description: Stomach ulcers (peptic ulcers) are sores in the lining of the stomach or duodenum.
treatment: Acid suppression and H. pylori eradication

name: Strep A
symptoms: Sore throat, fever, scarlet fever rash
description: Strep A infections range from strep throat to invasive disease.
first_aid: Seek medical care for severe sore throat

name: Stretch marks
causes: Rapid stretching of skin (pregnancy, weight gain)
symptoms: Red or purple lines on skin
description: Stretch marks are scars from rapid stretching of the skin.

name: Stroke
causes: Blocked or burst blood vessel in brain
symptoms: Sudden weakness, speech difficulty, facial droop
description: Stroke is a medical emergency where blood flow to part of the brain is interrupted.
first_aid: Call emergency services and note time of onset

name: Stroke (hemorrhagic)
description: Hemorrhagic stroke is bleeding in or around the brain.
treatment: Blood pressure management and possible surgery

name: Stroke (ischemic)
description: Ischemic stroke is caused by a blood clot blocking blood flow to the brain.

name: Stuttering, see Stammering
description: Stuttering (stammering) is a speech disorder with disrupted fluency.

name: Stye
description: A stye is a painful lump on the eyelid caused by a blocked gland.

name: Subarachnoid haemorrhage
description: Subarachnoid haemorrhage is bleeding into the space around the brain.

name: Subdural haematoma
description: Subdural haematoma is a collection of blood between the dura and brain.

name: Sunburn
description: Sunburn is skin damage from ultraviolet radiation.

name: Superficial thrombophlebitis
description: Superficial thrombophlebitis is inflammation of a superficial vein with clot formation.

name: Supraventricular tachycardia (SVT)
description: Supraventricular tachycardia is a rapid heart rhythm originating above the ventricles.

name: Swallowing pills, see Problems swallowing pills
description: Problems swallowing pills can be due to technique or underlying esophageal issues.
treatment: Alternative formulations or therapy for underlying cause

name: Sweat rash, see Heat rash (prickly heat)
description: Heat rash (miliaria) is caused by blocked sweat ducts.

name: Sweating (excessive), see Excessive sweating (hyperhidrosis)
description: Hyperhidrosis is excessive sweating that can be localized or generalized.

name: Swollen ankles, feet and legs (oedema)
causes: Heart failure, kidney disease, venous insufficiency
description: Swollen ankles are often a sign of fluid retention due to heart, kidney, or venous issues.

name: Syphilis
symptoms: Chancre in primary stage, rash in secondary
description: Syphilis is a sexually transmitted infection that can cause serious long-term complications if untreated.

name: Tailbone (coccyx) pain
description: Coccyx pain (coccydynia) is pain in the tailbone region.

name: Tapeworm
description: Tapeworm infection is a parasitic intestinal infection.

name: TB, see Tuberculosis (TB)
description: Tuberculosis is a bacterial infection primarily affecting the lungs.

name: Temporal arteritis
description: Temporal arteritis (giant cell arteritis) is inflammation of large and medium arteries.
first_aid: Seek urgent care for vision symptoms

name: Temporomandibular disorder (TMD)
description: Temporomandibular disorder causes pain and dysfunction in the jaw joint.

name: Tendonitis
symptoms: Pain and tenderness near a joint
description: Tendonitis is inflammation of a tendon.

name: Tennis elbow
symptoms: Pain on the outside of the elbow
description: Tennis elbow (lateral epicondylitis) is pain on the outside of the elbow from overuse.

name: Tension headaches
description: Tension-type headaches are the most common type of headache.

name: Testicular cancer
description: Testicular cancer is highly curable if detected early.

name: Tetanus
description: Tetanus is a serious bacterial infection causing painful muscle spasms.

name: Thalassaemia
description: Thalassaemia is an inherited blood disorder causing reduced hemoglobin production.

name: The 'male menopause'
description: The 'male menopause' (andropause) refers to age-related decline in testosterone levels.

name: Thoracic outlet syndrome
causes: Compression of nerves or blood vessels in the thoracic outlet
description: Thoracic outlet syndrome is compression of nerves or blood vessels in the thoracic outlet.

name: Threadworms
description: Threadworms are a common intestinal parasite causing itching around the anus.

name: Thrombophilia
description: Thrombophilia is an increased tendency to form blood clots.

name: Thrush in men and women
description: Thrush is a fungal infection caused by Candida yeast.

name: Thyroid (overactive), see Overactive thyroid (hyperthyroidism)
description: Hyperthyroidism is overproduction of thyroid hormones.

name: Thyroid (underactive), see Underactive thyroid (hypothyroidism)
description: Hypothyroidism is underproduction of thyroid hormones.

name: Thyroid cancer
description: Thyroid cancer is a malignancy of the thyroid gland with generally good prognosis.

name: TIA, see Transient ischaemic attack (TIA)
causes: Temporary blockage of blood flow to brain
description: Transient ischaemic attack is a temporary period of symptoms similar to those of a stroke.
treatment: Antiplatelet therapy and risk factor management

name: Tick-borne encephalitis (TBE)
description: Tick-borne encephalitis is a viral infection affecting the central nervous system.

name: Tics
causes: Tourette syndrome or other tic disorders
description: Tics are sudden, repetitive, nonrhythmic movements or vocalizations.

name: Tight foreskin (phimosis)
description: Phimosis is a condition where the foreskin cannot be retracted over the glans.

name: Tinnitus
causes: Hearing loss, ear injury, or circulatory issues
symptoms: Ringing or buzzing in the ears
description: Tinnitus is the perception of noise or ringing in the ears.

name: Toe pain
description: Toe pain can result from injury, arthritis, or other conditions.

name: Tongue-tie
description: Tongue-tie (ankyloglossia) is a condition where the tongue is tethered to the floor of the mouth.

name: Tonsillitis
description: Tonsillitis is inflammation of the tonsils.
treatment: Supportive care or tonsillectomy if recurrent

name: Tooth (chipped or broken)
description: A chipped or broken tooth can cause pain and risk of infection.

name: Tooth decay
description: Tooth decay (dental caries) is damage to teeth caused by bacterial acids.

name: Tooth knocked out
description: A knocked-out tooth (avulsed tooth) requires prompt action to save the tooth.
first_aid: Rinse tooth and place in milk or saliva
treatment: Reimplantation by dentist as soon as possible

name: Tourette syndrome
description: Tourette syndrome is a neurological disorder characterized by repetitive, involuntary movements and vocalizations.

name: Toxic shock syndrome
symptoms: High fever, rash, low blood pressure
description: Toxic shock syndrome is a rare, life-threatening condition caused by bacterial toxins.

name: Toxocariasis
description: Toxocariasis is an infection caused by roundworm larvae from dogs or cats.

name: Toxoplasmosis
symptoms: Often asymptomatic; flu-like in acute infection
description: Toxoplasmosis is a common parasitic infection that can be dangerous in pregnancy.

name: Transient ischaemic attack (TIA)
causes: Temporary blockage of blood flow to brain
description: Transient ischaemic attack is a temporary period of symptoms similar to those of a stroke.
treatment: Antiplatelet therapy and risk factor management

name: Trichomoniasis
description: Trichomoniasis is a common sexually transmitted parasitic infection.

name: Trichotillomania (hair pulling disorder)
symptoms: Recurrent pulling out of one's hair
description: Trichotillomania is a disorder involving recurrent pulling out of one's hair.

name: Trigeminal neuralgia
description: Trigeminal neuralgia is a chronic pain condition affecting the trigeminal nerve.

name: Trigger finger
description: Trigger finger is a condition where a finger gets stuck in a bent position.

name: Tuberculosis (TB)
description: Tuberculosis is a bacterial infection primarily affecting the lungs.

name: Turner syndrome
causes: Missing or partially missing X chromosome
description: Turner syndrome is a chromosomal disorder affecting females.

name: Type 1 diabetes
description: Type 1 diabetes is an autoimmune condition requiring lifelong insulin.

name: Type 2 diabetes
causes: Insulin resistance and relative insulin deficiency
description: Type 2 diabetes is the most common form, often linked to obesity.
treatment: Lifestyle changes, medication, and insulin if needed

name: Typhoid fever
description: Typhoid fever is a serious bacterial illness spread through contaminated food or water.
first_aid: Seek medical care for persistent high fever

name: Typhus
causes: Rickettsia bacteria transmitted by lice, fleas, or mites
description: Typhus is a group of diseases caused by Rickettsia bacteria.

name: Ulcerative colitis
description: Ulcerative colitis is a chronic inflammatory bowel disease affecting the colon.
treatment: Medication and surgery for severe cases

name: Umbilical hernia
description: Umbilical hernia is protrusion of abdominal contents through the umbilicus.

name: Underactive thyroid (hypothyroidism)
description: Hypothyroidism is underproduction of thyroid hormones.

name: Undescended testicles
description: Undescended testicles (cryptorchidism) is when one or both testicles fail to descend into the scrotum.

name: Urethritis
description: Urethritis is inflammation of the urethra, often due to sexually transmitted infections.

name: Urinary incontinence
causes: Weak pelvic floor or neurological issues
description: Urinary incontinence is the involuntary loss of urine.

name: Urinary tract infections (UTIs)
description: Urinary tract infections are common bacterial infections of the urinary system.

name: Uterine (womb) cancer
description: Uterine cancer (endometrial cancer) is a malignancy of the lining of the uterus.

name: Uveitis
description: Uveitis is inflammation of the uvea, the middle layer of the eye.

name: Vaginal cancer
description: Vaginal cancer is a rare malignancy of the vagina.

name: Vaginal pain, see Vulvodynia (vulval pain)
description: Vulvodynia is chronic pain or discomfort in the vulva without an identifiable cause.
treatment: Topical treatments and pelvic floor therapy

name: Vaginismus
description: Vaginismus is involuntary contraction of the vaginal muscles making penetration difficult or painful.
treatment: Pelvic floor physical therapy and counseling

name: Vaginitis
description: Vaginitis is inflammation of the vagina, often due to infection.

name: Varicose eczema
symptoms: Itchy, scaly skin on lower legs
description: Varicose eczema is skin inflammation due to poor venous circulation.

name: Varicose veins
description: Varicose veins are enlarged, twisted veins, most commonly in the legs.

name: Vascular dementia
causes: Reduced blood flow to the brain
description: Vascular dementia is caused by impaired blood flow to the brain.
treatment: Control hypertension and other risk factors

name: Vasculitis
description: Vasculitis is inflammation of blood vessels.

name: Venous leg ulcer
description: Venous leg ulcers are chronic wounds due to poor venous circulation.

name: Verrucas, see Warts and verrucas
description: Verrucas are plantar warts caused by HPV.

name: Vertigo
causes: Inner ear disorders or vestibular nerve issues
description: Vertigo is the sensation of spinning or dizziness.
treatment: Treat underlying cause and vestibular rehabilitation

name: Vestibular neuritis
causes: Viral infection of the vestibular nerve
description: Vestibular neuritis is inflammation of the vestibular nerve causing acute vertigo.

name: Vision loss
symptoms: Partial or complete loss of vision
description: Vision loss can be sudden or gradual from various eye conditions.
first_aid: Seek urgent ophthalmology care for sudden loss

name: Vitamin B12 or folate deficiency anaemia
description: Vitamin B12 or folate deficiency anaemia causes megaloblastic changes in blood cells.
drugs: Vitamin B12 or folic acid supplementation

name: Vitiligo
description: Vitiligo is a condition causing loss of skin pigment in patches.
treatment: Topical treatments, phototherapy, or skin grafting

name: Vomiting bug, see Norovirus (vomiting bug)
description: Norovirus is a highly contagious virus causing gastroenteritis.

name: Von Willebrand disease
causes: Deficiency or dysfunction of von Willebrand factor
description: Von Willebrand disease is the most common inherited bleeding disorder.

name: Vulval cancer
symptoms: Itching, lump, or ulcer on vulva
description: Vulval cancer is a rare malignancy of the vulva.

name: Vulvodynia (vulval pain)
description: Vulvodynia is chronic pain or discomfort in the vulva without an identifiable cause.
treatment: Topical treatments and pelvic floor therapy

name: Warts and verrucas
description: Warts and verrucas are benign skin growths caused by HPV.

name: Weil's disease, see Leptospirosis (Weil's disease)
description: Weil's disease is the severe form of leptospirosis.

name: Whiplash
description: Whiplash is a neck injury from sudden forceful movement of the head.

name: White blood cell count (low)
description: Low white blood cell count (leukopenia) increases susceptibility to infections.

name: Whitlow finger
causes: Herpes simplex virus infection of the finger
description: Herpetic whitlow is a herpes infection of the finger.

name: Whooping cough
description: Whooping cough is a highly contagious respiratory infection.

name: Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome
description: Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome is a heart rhythm disorder with an extra electrical pathway.

name: Womb (uterus) cancer
description: Uterine cancer (endometrial cancer) is a malignancy of the lining of the uterus.

name: Women's health
description: Women's health encompasses a wide range of medical conditions specific to women.

name: Worms in humans
description: Worms in humans refer to various intestinal parasitic infections.
